jobs.description: Clinical Data - Medinol Overview Technical Specifications Clinical Data Case Studies Ordering Information EluNIR TM Medinol Drug-Eluting Stents EluNIR's extensive clinical program demonstrated remarkable clinical outcomes in comparison to top-performing Drug Eluting Stents. EluNIR has an optimized efficacy and safety profile, as evidenced by its low rates of TLF and Stent Thrombosis. TLF Target Lesion Failure The efficacy profile of EluNIR remains strong for a duration of 1 to 2 years when compared to other top-performing drug-eluting stents. EluNIR presents outstanding clinical results with a low TLF of 7.0% at 2 years 1 . jobs.description: Overview - Medinol Overview Technical Specifications Clinical Data Case Studies Ordering Information EluNIR – PERL TM Ridaforolimus Eluting Coronary Stent System EluNIR-PERL is Medinol’s most recent advancement in coronary DES. This seventh-generation stent utilizes a distinctive CoCr design composed of alternating struts widths and integrated radiopaque markers. Furthermore, the delivery system features a specialized radiopaque metal spring tip designed for navigating through complex anatomies. These design elements are intended to equip physicians with precise positional information, facilitating accurate stent placement during PCI procedures.
